title: Newhalo
description: Warm paper page (#f5f1ee) with pure black panels, white cards and black hairlines; one hot orange (#ff5e2b) with black text on it, and an amber-to-red gradient for the big statement heading. Regular-weight, wide, round grotesk type set large and tight; 4px corners on buttons, 8px on panels. Dark sibling: pure black page, warm graphite cards, white hairlines.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the hero, statement, footer and header panels switch themselves to the dark tokens, so they stay black on the paper page
Manrope stands in for the original's closed grotesk; weight 400 throughout
highlight → glow is the amber-to-red heading gradient; chart-1…5: orange, amber, red, blue, warm grey
